packed_rope.decode_tables: Transient L1 tables shared by Q/K within one call; final DRAM boundary unchanged. Logical user rows sliced before unpacking.
packed_rope.prefill: Tile-aligned internal working rows folded with matching cos/sin; DRAM transpose/view; public padding/masking/slicing unchanged.
packed_rope.precision: Original HiFi4/FP32-requested policy preserved; upstream rotary core-group default discrepancy documented in rope_optimization.md.
packed_rope.bound_basis: Conservative512MiB scratch allowance for Q/K rotary permutations at B32/S4096, within existing12GiB activation/CCL reserve; not a measured full-stack peak. No new weights/cache/persistent buffers.

ledger.weight_scope: Persistent model tensors, including untied embedding/head, RoPE and recurrence constants; physical tile payload, excluding bank padding. copies denotes representation multiplicity, not an extra byte multiplier.

ledger.reconciliation: Unitemized setup is scalar/helper/semaphore allocations and allocator bank padding not enumerated by tensor inventory. Warmup delta combines program-cache, trace and persistent allocations; it is not an isolated trace measurement. Shared DRAM workspace is counted once. Shared AR/native-RS L1 buffers are outside this DRAM ledger.

reserve_comparison.basis: Measured request reset/prefill/decode/sampling allocation peaks are additional to prepared allocator baseline, which already includes persistent CCL and traces. Trace bytes are separately isolated by release. Planning reserves are compared, not added again to measured peaks. Preparation checkpoints for external scratch are a separate scope.

allocator_checkpoints.basis: DRAM allocator checkpoints, not a peak measurement

external_preparation.scope: Full-stack external-pool preparation capacity and preservation probe; checkpoints are not peak measurements.
